API List.pdf:
--- Page 1 ---
API List
# Name Description
1 Administrative Data - District Get districts details District from District LGD Code
2 Administrative Data - Taluk Get Taluks details from District and Taluk LGD Code
3 Administrative Data - Revenue Village Get Revenue villages details from District,Taluk and Village LGD Code
4 District Spatial Extent Get district  from District LGD Code
5 Taluk Spatial Extent Get Taluk Extent from District and Taluk LGD Code
6 Revenue Village Spatial Extent Get Revenue Village Extent from District,Taluk and Village LGD Code
7 Attributes - GIS Get Map Column Attributes from Layer ID
8 Multi Feature Attributes - Based on Buffer Get Features within the Given buffer
9 Nearest Feature Get Nearest Feature from given latitude and longitude
10 Inside Boundary Check whether the Given Latitude and Longitude are within a Jurisdiction boundary
